note: Every blocker that prevents a defensible commercial contribution conclusion or a full-PASS milestone. Status is OPEN unless an external authorization produces the required evidence. MC-12 may not close an external blocker by inference.

blockers.title: Official ENC chart redistribution right for Spanish/Portuguese waters not granted
blockers.impact: NAV revenue cannot be justified for the target geography; the chart entitlement is the core paid feature and is also an input cost.
blockers.approvalRequired: Hydrographic-office or OEM chart distribution agreement (IHM/UKHO/Shom/IHO route)
blockers.requiredEvidence: Executed redistribution licence with territory, caching, update, per-device terms and price

blockers.title: Third-party commercial chart product cannot be redistributed under current terms
blockers.impact: The fastest route to chart coverage is contractually unavailable; an OEM agreement would be required.
blockers.approvalRequired: OEM/developer agreement with Garmin/Navionics or C-MAP
blockers.requiredEvidence: Signed OEM agreement or written permission with price schedule

blockers.title: Commercial marine-weather re-display right not granted
blockers.impact: WEATHER cannot be sold as a licensed-data product; provider terms, continuity and liability are unconfirmed.
blockers.approvalRequired: Weather data licence with commercial display and caching rights
blockers.requiredEvidence: Executed data licence and DPA, forecast-source attribution rules, price and SLA

blockers.title: NMEA 0183 licence and NMEA 2000 certification not held
blockers.impact: Any claimed NMEA interface or NMEA 2000 compatibility is unauthorised; the licence is also an unquantified one-off and recurring cost.
blockers.approvalRequired: NMEA membership/licence and, if claimed, NMEA 2000 certification
blockers.requiredEvidence: NMEA licence certificate and certification record; published NMEA 2000 fee schedule

blockers.title: Cellular IoT contract and SIM/eSIM supply not established
blockers.impact: WATCH recurring cost is UNKNOWN; a per-device-month connectivity cost cannot be evidenced.
blockers.approvalRequired: Operator or IoT MVNO agreement (procurement authorization)
blockers.requiredEvidence: Contract or formal quotation: data allowance, roaming, activation, overage, suspension, term

blockers.title: Cloud hosting agreement, DPA and data-residency decision not established
blockers.impact: Hosting cost is a modelled tariff only; no contractual service level, DPA or EU-region commitment exists.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Signed agreement/DPA with region, retention, egress and support terms

blockers.title: Production map-tile right or self-hosted tile stack not established
blockers.impact: A basemap is required for the navigation surface; OSM tile policy prohibits the required load.
blockers.approvalRequired: Commercial tile provider agreement or self-hosting decision
blockers.requiredEvidence: Tile agreement with quota/price or a costed self-hosted stack

blockers.title: Source IP clearance not cleared (inherited)
blockers.impact: No product may be represented as free of third-party IP claims; no IP licensing revenue may be modelled.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Signed clearance opinion covering source and third-party components

blockers.title: MAREA trademark legal clearance not granted (inherited)
blockers.impact: The brand is proposed; no registered-mark claim and no brand-derived premium may be modelled.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Clearance opinion with territory and class coverage

blockers.title: Conformity and certification cost UNKNOWN in all 90 MC-11 scenarios
blockers.impact: No hardware contribution can be treated as complete; certification may be material and is recurring through the support period.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Formal EMC/RED/environmental/CRA quotations and a conformity budget

blockers.title: No supplier quotation, MOQ, lead time or Incoterms
blockers.impact: Unit variable cost is assumption-based; observed public-price coverage is only 0.8-4.7% of the modelled subtotal.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Formal supplier quotations for every material line

blockers.title: Tooling/NRE quotation absent; only an engineering envelope exists
blockers.impact: Tooling amortisation is an assumption; no fixed-investment figure can be used for financing.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Quotes for enclosure tooling, stencils, fixtures, programming jig, optical bonding

blockers.title: VAT status of input prices unresolved (37 of 42 observations VAT_UNKNOWN)
blockers.impact: An ex-VAT input cost cannot be claimed; recoverable input VAT treatment is unknown.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Documented VAT treatment per input and purchase route

blockers.title: Observed EUR/USD rate not retrieved; FX is an engineering assumption
blockers.impact: USD-denominated component prices carry an unverified conversion; the earlier ECB retrieval failed.
blockers.requiredEvidence: ECB euro reference rate with date, recorded as OBSERVED_RATE

blockers.title: Customer evidence NONE and willingness to pay unvalidated
blockers.impact: Every revenue figure is a hypothesis; no demand, price acceptance or retention rate is evidenced.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Executed interviews and pricing responses with recorded consent

blockers.title: Installer and distributor margins and service prices not established
blockers.impact: Channel economics are hypotheses only; no negotiated rate exists.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Signed distributor/installer terms or formal quotations

blockers.title: PILOT safety gate BLOCKED
blockers.impact: PILOT cannot be sold, priced as a fixed SKU or included as a firm commercial component; only a survey-based quotation model may be described.
blockers.approvalRequired: Safety case, independent assessment, supervised trials
blockers.requiredEvidence: Documented safety case and independent sign-off

blockers.title: CE/EMC/RED conformity not started
blockers.impact: No product may be placed on the EU market; conformity cost is part of the unit economics and is unknown.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Test reports, declaration of conformity, technical file

blockers.title: CRA cybersecurity obligations make firmware maintenance a recurring cost
blockers.impact: Security support for the support period is a recurring engineering obligation, not a one-off.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Support-period policy, SBOM/CVD process, security-update budget

blockers.title: GDPR controller/processor roles, DPIA and processor agreements not established
blockers.impact: Data-protection operations are a recurring cost driver and a legal precondition for telemetry services.
blockers.requiredEvidence: DPIA, records of processing, DPAs, retention schedule

blockers.title: Product liability insurance premium UNKNOWN
blockers.impact: A potentially material fixed and per-unit cost cannot be quantified.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Broker quotation for product liability cover

blockers.title: No price approved; every price is an unapproved hypothesis
blockers.impact: No catalogue, checkout, advertisement or structured data may publish a price.
blockers.approvalRequired: Pricing decision after cost, licensing and customer evidence
blockers.requiredEvidence: Approved price list with margin and evidence backing

blockers.title: AIS transmission is not an authorised offering
blockers.impact: Only receive-only AIS integration may be modelled; transmission would require radio licensing and is prohibited.
blockers.approvalRequired: Radio licensing and maritime approval (not pursued)
blockers.requiredEvidence: None within MC-12; must remain out of scope
